ctx.x: I think, and we might ask if there's any other old-time clarinetists. I mean, we know George, and I've heard all the later fellas, but amongst the old timers, were there any, like George or Boyd? Do you remember him? Yeah.
Yes, you boy, sure too. Were there any others about that time that are dead that you were your favorites? Oh, Miller Bonds was real good.
